read git and diff -u patches: paths, new/deleted/rename headers, hunks, byte-exact line content
column7: Probe on a real git diff (CRLF file, no final newline, add, delete, pure rename, rename with change): file names, new/deleted modes and renames are read correctly, but lines come from BufferedReader.readLine so the CR of a CRLF line is dropped ("line1\r" read as "line1"); "\ No newline at end of file" is one file-level flag (isNoNewLineAtTheEndOfTheFile) that cannot say which side lost the newline; parseUnifiedDiff(InputStream) decodes with the platform charset and the Reader constructor is package-private (JDK 17 on Windows, file.encoding Cp1252: a UTF-8 "café" line no longer equals the file's line)
column8: gap code: PatchParser reads the patch as bytes (about 230 lines); no production dependency

column1: apply hunks with exact context, no fuzz, line endings and missing final newline kept
column7: Probe: refuses a changed context and a shifted hunk with PatchFailedException CONTENT_DOES_NOT_MATCH_TARGET (exact, as required), but it works on List<String> lines without terminators, so the output cannot keep CRLF lines, mixed line ends or a missing final newline as the file and the patch have them
column8: gap code: HunkApplier compares and writes byte lines with their terminators (about 70 lines)

column8: test-scope dependency only (not shipped with the plugin)

column8: not used; this plugin is maven-code-patch-plugin with goal prefix code-patch so it collides with neither

column1: plan, stage, verify, apply with a reviewed plan id; backups, receipt, serialized promotion
column2: private patch goal family of two private Maven plugins (plan/stage/verify/apply mojos, patch planner, patch file/hunk records, import and rollback receipts)
column5: Apache-2.0 (as declared in the donor files)
column7: The donor goals run git and GitHub operations, workspace locality classifiers and a Java-only fixed-point recipe through project-specific engines and hashing schemas; only the contract carries over (see README: contract kept and dropped)
column8: contract kept, no code copied; generic implementation written here

column1: find a donor on the OpenClaw donor surface for unified-diff apply, path containment and transactional promotion
column4: 97 repositories listed by gh repo list openclaw on 2026-11-17; local harvest heads 2026-07-12
column7: searched all 97 names and descriptions for patch, diff, apply and path safety, then read the four hits in the local harvest: openclaw/openclaw src/agents/apply-patch.ts (d9623bd) reads the *** Begin Patch / *** Update File format, not unified diffs, and seekSequence retries with trimEnd, trim and punctuation normalizers (fuzzy, breaks the exact contract); openclaw/clawpatch (69014be) runs a provider fix loop in a git worktree and has no diff applier; openclaw/crabbox (6da7760) pipes diffs to git apply --whitespace=nowarn (see the git apply row); openclaw/fs-safe (6f358b3) is a Node.js root-bounded file system whose refusals (.., symbolic link swaps) match the TargetPaths contract, but it is TypeScript for Node and cannot run in a Maven plugin
column8: no code taken; TargetPaths keeps the same containment contract (relative paths resolved under a root, real locations checked, links refused) in Java

column1: apply patches by running git apply as a command
column7: probe (J:/patch-work/cli-probe/probe.sh, outside a repository, core.autocrlf=false): a hunk for lines 2-4 of a file with an extra first line was applied at line 3 with exit 0 and no message (offset search; a hunk at line 1 is held to the file start), so a shifted hunk is not refused; it refused fuzz (changed context), an LF hunk on a CRLF file, a trailing-space context mismatch and a ../ path, kept CRLF lines and a missing final newline; it has no plan id, approval, receipt or rollback, and it needs an installed git executable
column8: not used; HunkApplier applies each hunk only at the line its header names

column1: apply patches by running GNU patch as a command
column7: probe (same script, patch -p1): applied a shifted hunk with offset 1 line at line 1 and in the middle, applied a changed context with fuzz 1 (default fuzz 2), applied an LF hunk to a CRLF file and rewrote the whole file with LF line ends, refused a CRLF hunk on a CRLF file (different line endings), applied a trailing-space context mismatch with fuzz 1, refused a ../ path, kept a missing final newline; no plan id, approval, receipt or rollback
column8: not used (the retired maven-patch-plugin ran it); exact context and byte-exact line ends are written here
